question: BrahMos supersonic missile is a joint venture between _________ . (RRB NTPC CBT-I (29/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: India and Russia
India and China
India and UK
India and USA
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is India and Russia

Explanation:
The BrahMos missile is a joint venture between India and Russia, developed by BrahMos Aerospace. It is a supersonic cruise missile with a speed of Mach 2.8 to 3.0. The name BrahMos is derived from the Brahmaputra and Moskva rivers. Its first test was in 2001. Currently, it is deployed in the Indian Navy, Army, and Air Force. Russia provided ramjet technology, while India contributed navigation systems. BrahMos can be launched from land, ships, and aircraft.

question: A lie detector apparatus is also known as a: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Polygraph
Seismograph
Barograph
Polarimeter
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Polygraph

Explanation:
A lie detector apparatus is known as a polygraph. It is a device that measures physiological responses such as heart rate, blood pressure, respiration rate, and skin conductivity. These measurements record changes in a person's bodily reactions when questions are asked during the test. Polygraphs are often used in law enforcement and security screening, although their reliability is debated. It is also commonly referred to as a 'lie detector machine'.

question: Which among the following unit is used to count the speed of modern printers? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: BIT
LPM
PPM
CPM
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is PPM

Explanation:
The speed of modern printers is measured in PPM (Pages Per Minute). This unit indicates how many pages a printer can print in one minute. PPM is primarily used for measuring the speed of modern printers such as laser printers and inkjet printers. LPM (Lines Per Minute) and CPM (Characters Per Minute) were used for older dot matrix printers, while BIT is a unit for measuring data. Therefore, PPM is the correct unit for counting the speed of modern printers.

question: With reference to GPS, which of the following is correct? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Mountains and building blocks can act as obstacles to GPS signals.
Its full form is Global Placing System.
It has been developed by Russia
Its full form is Galileo Positioning System.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mountains and building blocks can act as obstacles to GPS signals.

Explanation:
GPS stands for Global Positioning System, developed by the United States. It uses satellites to provide precise location data on Earth. GPS signals are based on radio waves that travel in a straight line. Therefore, obstacles like mountains, tall buildings, and dense forests can block or weaken these signals, causing inaccuracies in positioning. This is why GPS may be less reliable in urban areas or mountainous regions. Other options are incorrect: 'Global Placing System' is a misnomer, Russia developed GLONASS, and Galileo is the European Union's system.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of GPS? → Global Positioning System
☛ Which country developed GPS? → USA
☛ Factors that can obstruct GPS signals? → Mountains, buildings, atmospheric conditions
☛ Russia's satellite navigation system? → GLONASS
☛ European Union's navigation system? → Galileo

options_hi: पहाड़ और इमारतें GPS सिग्नल में बाधा बन सकती हैं।

इसका पूरा नाम गैलीलियो पोजिशनिंग सिस्टम है।
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है पहाड़ और इमारतें GPS सिग्नल में बाधा बन सकती हैं।

Explanation:
GPS का पूरा नाम ग्लोबल पोजिशनिंग सिस्टम है, जो अमेरिका द्वारा विकसित किया गया है। यह उपग्रहों के माध्यम से पृथ्वी पर किसी भी स्थान की सटीक स्थिति बताता है। GPS सिग्नल रेडियो तरंगों पर आधारित होते हैं, जो सीधी रेखा में यात्रा करते हैं। इसलिए, पहाड़, ऊंची इमारतें, घने जंगल जैसी बाधाएं सिग्नल को अवरुद्ध कर सकती हैं, जिससे स्थान निर्धारण में त्रुटि होती है। यही कारण है कि शहरी क्षेत्रों या पहाड़ी इलाकों में GPS कभी-कभी कम सटीक होता है। अन्य विकल्प: 'ग्लोबल प्लेसिंग सिस्टम' और 'गैलीलियो पोजिशनिंग सिस्टम' गलत नाम हैं, जबकि रूस ने GLONASS विकसित किया है।

question: Which device is used to measure the relative density of the fluid? (RPF Constable 2018 (25/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Hydrometeor
Hydrometer
Anonymous
Venturiometry
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Hydrometer

Explanation:
A hydrometer is used to measure the relative density (specific gravity) of a liquid. It works on Archimedes' principle, which states that a body immersed in a fluid experiences an upward buoyant force equal to the weight of the fluid displaced. The hydrometer is a graduated glass tube with a weighted bulb at the bottom. When placed in a liquid, it floats and sinks to a depth depending on the liquid's density. Lower density causes it to sink deeper; higher density makes it float higher. Hydrometers are commonly used to measure the density of battery acid, milk, and alcohol. Other options: Hydrometeor refers to atmospheric phenomena, Venturimeter measures flow rate, and Anonymous is unrelated.

question: In April 2025, IN-SPACe launched an initiative inviting private firms to develop modular satellite platforms to host multiple payloads, aiming to reduce reliance on foreign satellite infrastructure. What is this initiative called? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (13/08/2025) Shift 2)

question: Financial inclusion helps reduce income inequality in rural areas. Which platform provides a unified digital database for unorganised workers? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (19/08/2025) Shift 3)

सॉफ्टवेयर टेक्नोलॉजी पार्क्स ऑफ इंडिया (STPI) एक स्वायत्त संगठन है जो इलेक्ट्रॉनिकी और सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्रालय (MeitY) के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है। इसकी स्थापना 1991 में की गई थी जिसका उद्देश्य भारत में सॉफ्टवेयर निर्यात और आईटी सेवाओं को बढ़ावा देना है। STPI ने पूरे भारत में आईटी/आईटीईएस उद्योग के लिए बुनियादी ढांचा, इन्क्यूबेशन सुविधाएं और निर्यात-उन्मुख सेवाएं प्रदान करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई है। इसके केंद्रों ने स्टार्टअप्स और एमएसएमई को सशक्त बनाने में मदद की है। यह संगठन इलेक्ट्रॉनिक हार्डवेयर और सॉफ्टवेयर क्षेत्रों के विकास में योगदान देता है।
